scope: valid native 4x4 to 2x2 convolution; T10 C96 N96 K864; signed32 pre-norm linear output
mode_0: og,p,channel-pair,tap; source read per output position
mode_1: channel-pair,native-yx; source read once; then legal destination og,p
mode_2: og,channel-pair,tap; cache four output positions; reuse each live weight vector

psum.read_write_policy: separate PS_READ and ADD_WRITE states; eight updates in parallel

datapath_adders.sharing: weight pair sum and psum update time-multiplexed; no multipliers

live_mask.implementation: configuration flip-flops and bounded combinational lookup/OR
live_mask.group: N8 x Cin4 x all 9 taps
live_mask.common_permission: skip dead C4 loop runs before reading source; cancel dead W rows before fetch

configuration.counting: first tile: 12193+core cycles; each subsequent fresh tile with resident W/mask: 1537+core cycles; repeated TB command only tests persistent-state correctness

output.handshake: ready/valid; data and address stable while stalled

finite_capacity_policy: one resident source tile, one complete weight layer, one complete output tile; no overlap, spilling, unbounded queues, hidden replay or alternative memory mapping
physical_scope: RTL explicit banks and registered read states; no SRAM macro/ASIC mapping, EDA, area, frequency or energy result
not_included: upstream noncausal PSN and native temporal-word production
full-frame traversal and tile overlap management

native_boundary.rule: RTL tests signed origin plus local coordinates; invalid native reads return zero without a source-bank access
